audit_ledger.status: future WP4.2 control-plane table; never in delete allowlist; purge role cannot update/delete prior audit rows

execution_constraints: Use individual DELETE statements in one transaction; no TRUNCATE, CASCADE, DROP SCHEMA, dynamic all-table discovery, or broad grant.
Capture IDs of organizations belonging to test tenants before deleting parent/tenant rows; use that frozen set for organization-scoped control-plane row predicates.
Require exact migration inventory match; any new table without an explicit preserve/delete row policy fails before SQL.
Write successful audit row in the same transaction as purge and deterministic reseed.
Refusal audit must not mutate the target before the target is independently verified.
This candidate list must be reviewed against current migration SQL and foreign-key graph before WP0.5 can pass.

purge_role_contract.forbidden: No DDL, no unrestricted DELETE, no UPDATE/DELETE on audit ledger, no production endpoint/credential, no app-role inheritance
